imputation: prior-training median for optional inputs only; fixed missingness indicators; required fp and role means never imputed
scaling: prior-training population mean and standard deviation; constant columns use scale 1
inner_design: expanding whole seasons inside outer training; one earlier season suffices for inner fit; equal-season mean paired MAE gain with baseline fallback for abstentions
selection_tie_break: higher paired MAE gain, higher coverage, core before trend, lower history threshold, larger alpha
outer_design: 2022-2025; all earlier admitted seasons; no cross-season labels or within-season train/test split

uncertainty.method: exhaustive bootstrap of equal-weight outer-season mean paired absolute-error gains
uncertainty.multiplicity: Bonferroni tail levels across all declared additional signatures and four positions; no pooling or best-profile selection
uncertainty.interpretation: descriptive temporal-block sensitivity only; four potentially dependent seasons cannot certify calibrated population coverage
additional_checks: exact one-sided season sign sensitivity under independent symmetric signs

ranking: conditional all-player same-season/week diagnostics only; Spearman lift, top-quartile precision and top-one regret; at least four candidates; canonical ID breaks ties
population: decision-week roster identities before target filtering; feature and label attrition reported separately; no target-informed candidate membership
output_policy: new immutable research revision; all folds, selections, feature masks, exclusions, forecasts and hashes; no legacy M5 or runtime writes
